blurb: Twin Brooks Horse Show Grounds offers over 10 acres of show grounds with two fenced arenas for flat classes and jumping. It hosts multiple horse shows throughout the year including open shows, schooling shows, jumper shows, gaming buckle series, and a Halloween jumper show. The grounds provide ample parking for trailers, water faucets, an enclosed secretary stand/show office, and a family-friendly atmosphere.
